Action: Letcatch(variable)

Related Actions: changecol, changeset, letpal, letset
Related Events: press, release, catch, fixcatch, drop, fixdrop
See also: FKiSS, Events, Actions

letcatch(variable)

First defined in: FKiSS3
The letcatch action sets the value of variable to number of the object currently being dragged by the user.
If no object is being dragged, variable is set to -1.
letcatch is used in the following events:
  • press
  • catch
  • release
  • fixcatch
  • drop
  • fixdrop

variable

variable must be a variable name.

Example:

;@ letcatch(C) ; Set variable C to the number of the object currently being dragged.
